articles.title_en: Courts, Crime and Economic Performance: Evidence from a Judicial Reform in Kenya
articles.title_cn: 法院、犯罪与经济表现：来自肯尼亚司法改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: The rule of law affects crime, and crime is an important obstacle to business in developing countries. In this paper, we study a criminal judicial reform aimed at increasing the speed of courts. In this reform called Active Case Management (ACM), judges are instructed to take more active control of their cases by organizing pre-trial conferences and setting up deadlines with the overall objective of reducing adjournments; i.e., postponements of hearings to later dates. Importantly, the reform was implemented only in some pilot courts, selected in a plausibly exogenous way. We employ a triple difference analysis, comparing the time to disposition of criminal cases versus civil cases, in treated courts versus control courts, for cases filed before and after the reform. We find an increase in the speed of courts. The quality of legal processes improves. More cases get completed. Crime reduces in the treated areas in the long run. Firms respond by spending less on protection against crime which affects their operations.
articles.abstract_cn: 法治影响犯罪，而犯罪是发展中国家商业的重要障碍。在本文中，我们研究了一项旨在提高法院速度的刑事司法改革。这项名为主动案件管理（ACM）的改革中，法官被指示通过组织审前会议和设定截止日期来更主动地控制案件，总体目标是减少休庭，即听证会推迟到更晚日期。重要的是，该改革仅在部分试点法院实施，这些法院的选择在看似外生的方式下进行。我们采用三重差分分析，比较改革前后提起的刑事案件与民事案件在试点法院与对照法院中的处理时间。我们发现法院速度提高。法律程序质量改善。更多案件得到完成。长期来看，试点地区的犯罪减少。企业通过减少用于防范犯罪的开支来应对，这影响了它们的运营。

articles.title_en: Early childhood human capital formation at scale
articles.title_cn: 大规模早期儿童人力资本形成
articles.abstract_en: Can governments leverage existing service-delivery platforms to scale early childhood development (ECD) interventions? We experimentally study a large-scale, low-cost home-visiting intervention – providing materials and counseling – integrated into Bangladesh’s national nutrition program without extra financial incentives for service providers (SPs). We find SPs partially substitute away from nutritional to ECD counseling. Intent-to-treat estimates show positive impacts on child’s cognition (0.17 SD), language (0.23 SD), and socio-emotional scores (0.12-0.14 SD). Wasting and underweight rates decline. Older siblings’ primary school attendance increases as well. Improved maternal agency, complementary parental investments, and higher take-up of the pre-existing nutrition program are important mechanisms. We estimate a sizeable internal rate-of-return of 18.9%.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府能否利用现有的服务提供平台来推广早期儿童发展（ECD）干预措施？我们通过实验研究了一项大规模、低成本的入户探访干预——提供材料和咨询——并将其整合到孟加拉国的国家营养计划中，且未向服务提供者（SPs）提供额外经济激励。我们发现服务提供者部分地从营养咨询转向ECD咨询。意向性治疗估计显示，对儿童认知（0.17标准差）、语言（0.23标准差）和社会情感得分（0.12-0.14标准差）有积极影响。消瘦和低体重率下降。年长兄弟姐妹的小学出勤率也有所提高。母亲能动性的改善、补充性父母投资以及既有营养计划参与率的提高是重要机制。我们估计内部收益率相当可观，为18.9%。

articles.title_en: The long-run impacts of adolescent drinking: Evidence from Zero Tolerance Laws
articles.title_cn: 青少年饮酒的长期影响：来自零容忍法律的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides the first long-run assessment of adolescent alcohol control policies on later-life health and labor market outcomes. Our analysis exploits cross-state variation in the rollout of “Zero Tolerance” (ZT) Laws, which set strict alcohol limits for drivers under age 21 and led to sharp reductions in youth binge drinking. We adopt a difference-in-differences approach that combines information on state and year of birth to identify individuals exposed to the laws during adolescence and tracks the evolving impacts into middle age. We find that ZT Laws led to significant improvements in later-life health. Individuals exposed to the laws during adolescence were substantially less likely to suffer from cognitive and physical limitations in their 40s. The health effects are mirrored by improved labor market outcomes. These patterns cannot be attributed to changes in educational attainment or marriage. Instead, we find that affected cohorts were significantly less likely to drink heavily by middle age, suggesting an important role for adolescent initiation and habit-formation in affecting long-term substance use.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次对青少年酒精控制政策对晚年健康和劳动力市场结果的长期影响进行了评估。我们的分析利用了“零容忍”（ZT）法律实施中的跨州差异，该法律对21岁以下驾驶员设定了严格的酒精限制，并导致青少年狂饮行为大幅减少。我们采用双重差分方法，结合州和出生年份的信息来识别在青少年时期暴露于该法律的个体，并追踪其影响直至中年。我们发现，零容忍法律显著改善了晚年健康。在青少年时期暴露于该法律的个体在40岁时出现认知和身体限制的可能性大幅降低。健康效应与劳动力市场结果的改善相呼应。这些模式不能归因于教育程度或婚姻状况的变化。相反，我们发现受影响的队列在中年时大量饮酒的可能性显著降低，这表明青少年时期的饮酒起始和习惯形成在影响长期物质使用方面发挥着重要作用。

articles.title_en: The labor market impacts of America’s first paid maternity leave policy
articles.title_cn: 美国首个带薪产假政策对劳动力市场的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides new evidence on the effect of a national expansion of paid maternity leave on the labor-market outcomes of women in the United States. I develop an identification strategy that exploits the staggered expansion of paid leave through short-term disability insurance in the 1960s and 1970s. The policy expanded leave-taking among new mothers but also precipitated a decrease in hourly wages, employment, and family income among women of child-bearing age. The results suggest that even modestly generous, widespread expansions of paid family leave policies have the potential to widen gender gaps in the labor market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于全国性带薪产假扩展对美国女性劳动力市场结果影响的新证据。我开发了一种识别策略，利用1960年代和1970年代通过短期残疾保险逐步扩展带薪休假的机会。该政策增加了新妈妈的休假时间，但也导致了育龄女性的小时工资、就业和家庭收入下降。结果表明，即使是适度慷慨、广泛推广的带薪家庭休假政策，也可能扩大劳动力市场中的性别差距。

articles.title_en: Inside the West Wing: Lobbying as a contest
articles.title_cn: 白宫内部：作为竞赛的游说
articles.abstract_en: When a government makes many different policy decisions, lobbying can be viewed as a contest between the government and many different special interest groups. The government fights lobbying by interest groups with its own political capital. In this world, we find that a government wants to ‘sell protection’ – give favourable treatment in exchange for contributions – to certain interest groups. It does this in order to build its own ‘war chest’ of political capital, which improves its position in fights with other interest groups. And it does so until it wins all remaining contests with certainty. This stands in contrast to existing models that often view lobbying as driven by information or agency problems.
articles.abstract_cn: 当政府做出许多不同的政策决定时，游说可以被视为政府与许多不同特殊利益集团之间的竞赛。政府用自己的政治资本来对抗利益集团的游说。在这个世界中，我们发现政府想要‘出售保护’——以给予优惠待遇换取捐款——给某些利益集团。它这样做是为了建立自己的政治资本‘战争基金’，这改善了它与其他利益集团斗争中的地位。而且它会一直这样做，直到它确定赢得所有剩余竞赛。这与现有模型形成对比，后者通常将游说视为由信息或代理问题驱动。

articles.title_en: The limits of social recognition: Experimental evidence from blood donors
articles.title_cn: 社会认可的限度：来自献血者的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Does social recognition motivate prosocial individuals? We run large-scale experiments at Italy’s main blood donors association, evaluating social recognition through social media and peer groups against a simple ask to donate. Across several studies, we find that the simple ask is at least as effective as offering social recognition. In a survey experiment with blood donors we show that socially recognized donations signal not only altruism but also image-seeking. This can lead to social recognition being less effective, or even counterproductive, when offered to those who are already perceived as good citizens.
articles.abstract_cn: 社会认可能否激励亲社会个体？我们在意大利主要献血者协会进行了大规模实验，评估通过社交媒体和同伴群体提供的社会认可与简单请求献血的效果。在多项研究中，我们发现简单请求至少与社会认可同样有效。在一项针对献血者的调查实验中，我们表明，获得社会认可的献血不仅传递了利他主义，也传递了追求形象的信号。这可能导致社会认可在提供给那些已被视为好公民的人时效果减弱，甚至适得其反。

articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a two-wave survey experiment to examine the impact of self-image concerns on voting behavior. We elicit votes on a ballot initiative on animal welfare in Switzerland that spurred campaigns involving widely shared normative values. We send a message to voters about scientific evidence supporting the claim that “good-hearted people tend to be good to animals.” We interpret this message as a factor that may alter the self-signaling value linked to voting in favor of the initiative. We investigate how this message affects selection and processing of information, as well as reported voting behavior. We find that the message is effective in several ways: voters agree more with arguments in favor of the initiative, are more likely to anticipate voting in favor, and do report having voted in favor of the initiative more often.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过一项两波调查实验，考察自我形象关注对投票行为的影响。我们在瑞士就一项涉及广泛共享规范性价值观的动物福利投票倡议进行了投票征集。我们向选民发送了一条关于科学证据支持“心地善良的人往往对动物友善”这一说法的信息。我们将此信息解释为可能改变与投票支持该倡议相关的自我信号价值的因素。我们研究了这一信息如何影响信息的选择和处理，以及报告的投票行为。我们发现该信息在多个方面有效：选民更同意支持该倡议的论点，更可能预期投票支持，并且确实更频繁地报告投票支持该倡议。

articles.title_en: Why are older men working more? The role of social security
articles.title_cn: 为什么老年男性工作更多？社会保障的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the role of Social Security reforms in explaining the increase in labor supply of older men across cohorts and evaluates the labor response by health status. I develop and estimate a rich dynamic life-cycle model of labor supply, savings, and Social Security application that captures the key structure of Social Security retirement benefits, disability insurance, and pension systems, while accounting for uncertainties in health, survival, wages, and medical expenditures. The model matches well the observed life-cycle profiles of employment, hours per worker, and savings for men in the 1930s cohort from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics. I find that Social Security reforms account for over 77% of the observed rises in employment and hours worked by the 1950s cohort, with the retirement earnings test reforms being the most important. The labor response is smaller for unhealthy individuals due to the work disincentives provided by disability benefits.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了社会保障改革在解释不同队列老年男性劳动力供给增加中的作用，并评估了不同健康状况下的劳动力反应。我开发并估计了一个丰富的动态生命周期模型，涵盖劳动力供给、储蓄和社会保障申请，该模型捕捉了社会保障退休福利、残疾保险和养老金制度的关键结构，同时考虑了健康、生存、工资和医疗支出方面的不确定性。该模型很好地匹配了来自收入动态面板研究中1930队列男性观察到的生命周期就业、人均工作小时数和储蓄概况。我发现社会保障改革解释了1950队列观察到的就业和工作小时数上升的超过77%，其中退休收入测试改革最为重要。由于残疾福利提供的工作抑制因素，不健康个体的劳动力反应较小。

articles.title_en: The (in)visible hand: Do workers discriminate against employers?
articles.title_cn: （不）可见的手：工人是否歧视雇主？
articles.abstract_en: Although a large literature has studied discrimination in the labor market, there is little evidence on sex- and race-based discrimination of workers against (potential) employers. We implement a randomized experiment in an online labor market to contribute to this gap in the literature. In our experiment, workers make labor-supply decisions after we randomly expose them to signals about the race and sex of the employer. Our empirical analysis provides fairly strong evidence that workers discriminate against black employers when making labor effort decisions. Race-based discrimination is driven primarily by white workers against black male employers. We find weaker and less conclusive evidence of a favorable sex gap toward female employers. An additional survey with randomized components suggests that perceived differences in the likelihood that an employer honors the labor contract does not differ by employer race or sex.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管大量文献研究了劳动力市场中的歧视，但关于工人对（潜在）雇主的性别和种族歧视的证据却很少。我们在在线劳动力市场中实施了一项随机实验，以填补这一文献空白。在我们的实验中，工人在我们随机向其透露雇主种族和性别信号后做出劳动供给决策。我们的实证分析提供了相当有力的证据，表明工人在做出劳动努力决策时歧视黑人雇主。种族歧视主要由白人工人对黑人男性雇主的歧视驱动。我们发现对女性雇主存在有利性别差距的证据较弱且不太确定。一项带有随机成分的额外调查表明，对雇主履行劳动合同可能性的感知差异并不因雇主种族或性别而异。
